text:
sasha: Heads-up from procurement: the H100 bulk shipment (50 units) is held at FRA customs, possible HS reclassification.
koray_vendor: apologies, FRA broker flagged missing end-use paperwork. forwarder AWB 987-6543210 on hold.
ops-bot: created INC-3399 for customs hold + provisional RMA mapping.
ben: ETA impact? we have Dedicated pool scale scheduled Fri.
koray_vendor: estimate 4-9 business days after docs are submitted. we pushed initial paperwork to broker today.
hannah: any chance of partial release so we can at least stage depot photos and serials?
koray_vendor: FRA approved an immediate partial release of 8 units (crates R-01..R-08). rest remain on hold.
ana: (cc @ana) infra can rebalance: we can divert low-priority traffic to quantized A800s, expect ~25-35% throughput hit on batching. need sign-off to flip routing rules.
ana: also recommend we pre-warm KV cache on targets to reduce tail latency spike when we flip.
ana: (fixing typo) meant to tag @ana.
ana: @sasha @ben want us to proceed with the A800 fallback for background workloads?
sasha: yes for batch only. keep latency-critical routes pinned to current pool.
hannah: koray_vendor, can you provide serial->crate mapping and provisional RMA labels for the 8 cleared units? we want to pre-stage depot manifest and ID checks.
koray_vendor: sending CSV `fra_release_8_serials.csv` to INC-3399 in ~10m. includes serials, model, crate_id, provisional RMA label string and photos pending inspection.
ben: procurement needs commercial remediation proposal. what credit or fee offset are you proposing for the delay?
koray_vendor: proposing a 6% line credit on `PO-H100-050` to cover handling and delay. can discuss higher if hold >10 days.
sasha: please include broker contact + invoice breakout. finance will fast-track if details included.
koray_vendor: will attach `broker_contact=fra-broker@forwarder.co`, `invoice_ref=PO-H100-050`, `proposed_credit=6%` in the ticket.
hannah: depot acceptance needs high-res dock photos and crate condition notes for RMA inbound. koray_vendor, can you upload within the hour?
koray_vendor: yes, inspector will upload photos to INC-3399 and mark which serials pass initial inspection.
ana: ops note: when we shift traffic to A800s, add a short-term billing alert in Console for token cost delta and an SLO monitor for p95/p99. flag #eng-runtime if p99 increases >10%.
ben: cost decision: if FRA clears within 7 days we hold. if not, we evaluate an expedited buy (local spot H100s) vs re-route to CDG with expedite fees. which is cheaper depends on spot pricing and re-route tariffs.
sasha: procurement to run cost calc; koray_vendor, keep us posted on any sign-offs from FRA customs — ping this thread.
koray_vendor: will update INC-3399 and ping here when CSV/photos live. thanks. :thumbsup:
